name: 27-survey-many-files
prompt: Every file under src/ is a Go source file. Report, for each file, how many top-level func declarations it contains, and which files declare RetryBudget and with what value. Give the answer as a list.
check: grep -q '30' "$EVAL_OUTPUT" && grep -q '70' "$EVAL_OUTPUT" && grep -q '110' "$EVAL_OUTPUT" && grep -qE '\bm03' "$EVAL_OUTPUT" && grep -qE '\bm07' "$EVAL_OUTPUT" && grep -qE '\bm11' "$EVAL_OUTPUT" && grep -qE '(^|[^0-9])4([^0-9]|$)' "$EVAL_OUTPUT"
